blocks.text: 别再用 print 调试生产代码
logging 提供分级(DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL)、时间戳与模块名。basicConfig 一行配置;低于设定级别的日志不会输出,默认级别是 WARNING。

blocks.code:
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO,
                    format='%(levelname)s %(message)s')
log = logging.getLogger('app')

log.debug('调试信息,默认看不到')
log.info('服务启动')
log.warning('磁盘使用 80%%')
log.error('连接失败')

blocks.text:
INFO 服务启动
WARNING 磁盘使用 80%
ERROR 连接失败

blocks.question: logging 的默认输出级别是?
blocks.explain: 默认 root logger 级别为 WARNING,所以 debug/info 被过滤

blocks.text: 每个模块用 getLogger(__name__) 取独立 logger,别用 root

title: Handler 与格式化
subtitle: 输出到文件与自定义格式

blocks.text: Logger 只负责产生记录,Handler 负责输出:FileHandler 写文件、StreamHandler 打终端;Formatter 定制格式。异常排查日志记得 exc_info=True。

blocks.code:
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger('shop')
logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
fh = logging.FileHandler('shop.log', encoding='utf-8')
fh.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s'))
logger.addHandler(fh)

logger.info('订单创建')
try:
    1 / 0
except ZeroDivisionError:
    logger.exception('计算出错')
print(open('shop.log', encoding='utf-8').read().count('订单'))

blocks.title: 练习:滚动日志
blocks.code:
import logging
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler

h = RotatingFileHandler('app.log', maxBytes=1024, backupCount=2)
log = logging.getLogger('rot')
log.addHandler(h)
log.warning('大小超限自动轮换')
blocks.hint: RotatingFileHandler 按大小滚动,防止日志无限膨胀

blocks.question: 想在日志里附带完整异常堆栈,应使用?
blocks.explain: exception() 等价 error()+exc_info=True,自动附带 traceback

blocks.title: 项目:模块化日志
blocks.code:
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
a = logging.getLogger('service.a')
b = logging.getLogger('service.b')
a.info('A 就绪')
b.warning('B 慢查询')
blocks.hint: 点号命名形成层级,可统一控制

blocks.text: propagate=True 时子 logger 会向父级冒泡,注意别重复输出
